Holy... these are HUGE. Drag huge. As a makeup artist who goes through bulk lashes of all kinds often; these are the heftiest I’ve found at this size. My own lashes are very long & can accommodate 20mm lash extensions....the extra 5mm on these strip lashes are intense. For pure drama only. Nice variation in styles for the price & flexible band for decent shaping & adhesion. Depending on your eye width, you’ll most definitely need to cut these to size & trim to manipulate them.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the lashes as dramatic, long, and glamorous, with many loving the bold look.
Many customers consider the lashes a great value, calling the price affordable and worth it for the quality.
Several reviewers describe the lashes as soft and light.
Some customers note the lashes are very large and may need trimming to fit their eye shape.
A few negative reviews report issues with thinness, shedding, and not holding their curl or shape.
